definitions.name: Raspberry Pi RP2040
definitions.description: Bare-chip dual-core Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontroller in QFN-56 7×7 mm package. 264 KB SRAM with NO internal flash (external QSPI flash required for code execution via XIP). 30 multi-function GPIOs (GPIO0..GPIO29), 2x UART, 2x I2C, 2x SPI, 16 PWM channels (8 slices), 4-channel 12-bit ADC, USB 1.1 host/device PHY, and 8 user-programmable I/O state machines (PIO) across two PIO blocks. Flexible system clock up to 133 MHz default.

profiles.label: UART0 on GPIO28/29 (pins 40/41, no flow control)

interfaceGroups.label: USB PHY Mode (one PHY: device or host)

requirements.description: IOVDD digital I/O ring: six pins (1, 10, 22, 33, 42, 49) tied to one 1.8-3.3 V rail (typical 3.3 V) — mixing rails is not supported. Sets the logic level for all GPIOs and the QSPI interface.
DVDD digital core: 1.05-1.16 V (typ 1.1 V, Table 634) on pins 23 and 50 — from VREG_VOUT (typical; VREG_VIN accepts 1.8-3.3 V) or an external 1.1 V regulator. Must not be left floating.
USB_VDD: dedicated 3.135-3.63 V (typ 3.3 V) supply for the USB 1.1 PHY (pin 48). Must be supplied even if USB is unused.

No internal flash: the chip cannot boot or run user code without an external QSPI flash (typically 2-16 MB, Winbond W25Q-series compatible with the XIP boot ROM) on the dedicated QSPI pads (pins 51-56).
A 12 MHz crystal between XIN/XOUT (or a 12 MHz CMOS clock into XIN with XOUT open) is required for the USB bootloader.

package.name: QFN-56
package.source: https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rp2040/rp2040-datasheet.pdf (build-date 2025-02-20: §5.1 "The RP2040 7×7 mm QFN-56 package", "0.4mm QFN-56", central GND pad (ePad), D2/E2 3.0-3.2 mm, nominal 3.1; §5.5 Pinout, Table 621: GND 57, "Common ground connection via central pad")

definitions.name: Bosch BMI270
definitions.description: 6-axis IMU (16-bit accelerometer ±2/4/8/16 g, 16-bit gyroscope ±125-2000 dps) in a 14-pad LGA, 3.0 x 2.5 x 0.83 mm. Primary I2C (0x68/0x69, up to 1 MHz) or SPI (up to 10 MHz) target interface; secondary AUX I2C / OIS SPI. VDD 1.71-3.6 V, VDDIO 1.2-3.6 V.

params.description: SDO — primary interface: serial data output in SPI 4W; I2C address bit-0 select in I2C mode.
params.connect_to: SPI4W: SDO; SPI3W: DNC; I2C: GND for default I2C address

params.description: ASDx — secondary interface: Aux interface / OIS interface data (Aux SDA or OIS SDI).
params.connect_to: VDDIO or DNC or Aux SDA or OIS SDI; do not connect to GND if unused

params.description: ASCx — secondary interface: Aux interface / OIS interface clock (Aux SCL or OIS SCK).
params.connect_to: VDDIO or DNC or Aux SCL or OIS SCK; do not connect to GND if unused

params.description: INT1 — interrupt pin 1. If unused, do not connect. Can be configured as input for FIFO external data synchronization.
VDDIO — digital I/O supply voltage (1.2 … 3.6V).
GNDIO — ground for I/O.
GND — ground for digital & analog.
VDD — power supply analog & digital domain (1.71V – 3.6V).
INT2 — interrupt pin 2. If unused, do not connect. Can be configured as input for FIFO external data synchronization.
OCSB — secondary OIS interface chip select (digital in).
params.connect_to: DNC or OIS CSB; tie to GND only if IF_CONF.ois_en = 0

params.description: OSDO — secondary OIS interface serial data out (digital out).
params.connect_to: DNC or OIS SDO; tie to GND only if IF_CONF.ois_en = 0

params.description: CSB — primary interface chip select for SPI mode.
params.connect_to: SPI: CSB; I2C: VDDIO (DNC possible with internal pull-up, not recommended)

params.description: SCx — primary interface: SCK for SPI serial clock, SCL for I2C serial clock.
SDx — primary interface: SDA serial data I/O in I2C; SDI serial data input in SPI 4W; SDA (SDIO) serial data I/O in SPI 3W.

params.note: 14 metallized Cu pads on the underside, pitch 0.5 mm; side pads 0.475 x 0.25 mm, top/bottom pads 0.25 x 0.475 mm; package 3.00 x 2.50 x 0.83 mm.

interfaceGroups.label: Primary host interface (I2C or SPI, shared pads)
Secondary interface (AUX I2C or OIS SPI, shared pads)

package.name: LGA-14
package.source: https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/media/boschsensortec/downloads/datasheets/bst-bmi270-ds000.pdf (Basic description: "LGA mold package, 14 pins, footprint 2.5x3.0mm², height 0.83mm"; §8.1 package outline)

params.esd: HBM 2 kV, CDM 500 V, MM 200 V

definitions.name: TI TPS63020DSJR buck-boost converter
definitions.description: Single-inductor buck-boost converter with 4 A switches: VIN 1.8-5.5 V, adjustable VOUT 1.2-5.5 V (500 mV feedback), 2 A at VOUT 3.3 V for VIN > 2.5 V, 2.4 MHz, 25 uA quiescent, power-good output, VSON-14 (DSJ) 4 x 3 mm with exposed pad.

params.description: VINA — supply voltage for control stage.
GND — control / logic ground.
FB — voltage feedback of adjustable versions, must be connected to VOUT on fixed output voltage versions.
VOUT — buck-boost converter output (pins 4, 5).
VOUT — buck-boost converter output (pins 4, 5).
L2 — connection for inductor (pins 6, 7).
L2 — connection for inductor (pins 6, 7).
L1 — connection for inductor (pins 8, 9).
L1 — connection for inductor (pins 8, 9).
VIN — supply voltage for power stage (pins 10, 11).
VIN — supply voltage for power stage (pins 10, 11).
EN — enable input (1 enabled, 0 disabled), must not be left open. VIL <= 0.4 V, VIH >= 1.2 V.
PS/SYNC — enable / disable power save mode (1 disabled, 0 enabled, clock signal for synchronization), must not be left open. Sync range 2200-2600 kHz.
PG — output power good (1 good, 0 failure; open-drain), can be left open. VOL 0.04 V typ / 0.4 V max at 10 uA.
PGND — power ground. The exposed thermal pad is connected to PGND.

params.note: 14 leads, pitch 0.50 mm, lead width 0.18-0.30, length 0.30-0.50; body 3.85-4.15 x 2.85-3.15 x 0.80-1.00 mm; exposed pad 2.85 x 1.58 mm. MSL Level-1-260C-UNLIM, NIPDAU finish.

interfaces.name: Exposed thermal pad (heat path to PCB)

interfaceGroups.label: VIN pins 10 and 11 (both must be connected)
VOUT pins 4 and 5 (both must be connected)

package.name: VSON-14
package.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps63020.pdf (§5: "DSJ Package, 14-Pin VSON with Exposed Thermal Pad"; p.32 exposed pad 2.85 x 1.58 mm); https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/MPSS014A (body 3.85-4.15 x 2.85-3.15 x 0.80-1.00 mm, pitch 0.50)
package.assumption: TI numbers no exposed pad; "EP" is this part's label for it. Height 0.9 mm is the midpoint of 0.80-1.00 mm (see the assumption trait).

params.esd: HBM ±500 V (VIN, VINA, L1), ±2000 V other pins; CDM ±1500 V

scenarios.label: IMU SDx and INT1 swapped
scenarios.description: The IMU's SDx (u2 pin 14) is on the IMU_INT1 net and its INT1 (pin 4) on SDA: the I2C bus between the MCU and the IMU is incomplete.
